CNContactPicker.doc: A popover-based interface for selecting a contact.

CNContactViewController.doc: A view controller that displays a new, unknown, or existing contact.

CNContactPickerDelegate.doc: The methods that you implement to respond to contact-picker user events.

-showRelativeToRect:ofView:preferredEdge.doc: Shows the picker popover anchored to the specified view.

+descriptorForRequiredKeys.doc: Returns the descriptor for all the keys that must be fetched on the contact before setting it on the view controller.

+viewControllerForContact:.doc: Initializes a view controller for an existing contact.

+viewControllerForNewContact:.doc: Initializes a view controller for a new contact.

+viewControllerForUnknownContact:.doc: Initializes a view controller for an unknown contact.

-highlightPropertyWithKey:identifier:.doc: Highlights the property of the contact being displayed.

delegate.doc: The picker delegate to be notified when the user chooses a contact.

displayedKeys.doc: The keys to be displayed when a contact is expanded.

allowsActions.doc: Determines whether to display buttons for actions such as sending a text message or initiating a FaceTime call.

allowsEditing.doc: Determines whether the user can edit the contact’s information.

alternateName.doc: The name to use if the contact has no display name.

contactStore.doc: The contact store from which the contact was fetched or to which it will be saved.

displayedPropertyKeys.doc: The contact property keys to display.

init(forContact:).doc: Initializes a view controller for an existing contact.

message.doc: The message displayed under the name of the contact.

parentContainer.doc: The container in which to add a new contact.

parentGroup.doc: The group in which to add a new contact.

shouldShowLinkedContacts.doc: Determines whether to display data from contacts that are linked to the contact being displayed.
